segments.text: Greetings and welcome to the massive open online course Introduction to BioRisk Management.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎学习大规模开放在线课程“生物风险管理导论”。

segments.text: This course is being brought to you by University Malaysia Sabah in collaboration with the Commonwealth
segments.zh: 本课程由马来西亚沙巴大学与英联邦
学习共同体合作为大家提供。

segments.text: Biological agents pose a significant threat to public health and safety.
segments.zh: 生物因子对公共卫生和安全构成重大威胁。

segments.text: Biological agents include bacteria, viruses and other pathogens, which have the potential
segments.zh: 生物因子包括细菌、病毒和其他病原体，它们有可能

segments.text: to cause harm to healthy human subjects.
BioRisk Management involves three basic steps.
segments.zh: 生物风险管理包括三个基本步骤。

segments.text: The first step is Risk Assessment.
The BioSafety officer assesses the risk posed by the pathogen to the laboratory users using
segments.zh: 生物安全官通过全面的风险评估，
评估病原体对实验室使用者构成的风险。

segments.text: The next step of the procedure involves Risk Mitigation.
segments.zh: 流程的下一步是风险缓解。

segments.text: Risk Mitigation involves the application of the five controls to mitigate or reduce
segments.zh: 风险缓解是指实施五种控制措施，以减轻或降低

segments.text: the risk posed by a biological agent.
Finally, we move on to Performance Assessment.
segments.zh: 最后，我们进入绩效评估。

segments.text: Performance Assessment determines whether the controls are appropriate and in proper working
segments.zh: 绩效评估用来确定控制措施是否恰当、是否处于正常

segments.text: These three steps constitute the process of BioRisk Management.
segments.zh: 这三个步骤构成了生物风险管理的流程。

segments.text: Thank you for watching and stay bio safe.
segments.zh: 感谢观看，请注意生物安全。
